activity_summary: Garnish hung the plot and walked the hired men through the lists until they could find their feet. Burbage ran the prison speech twice, for nobody: "I wasted time, and now doth time waste me." Nick asked whether the gown shows. It does not. Kemp, passing, said "Sweet Master Shakespeare. How does the sweet tooth?" You did not give him a roll, and he did not ask for one in the play. You told him the dance is where he is saved.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the second reading, refused a third, and left Kemp off the plot.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Walked the lists, and confirmed Kemp is not on the plot.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Said the prison speech twice to an empty house.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Asked after the gown, and was told it does not show.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked after the sweet tooth, and kept to you, not thou.
